description: Source code for trigger support in the ISL29035 light sensor driver, including interrupt handling, configuration, and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: setup_int
methods.description: Configures the interrupt GPIO pin with enable or disable flags.

methods.name: handle_int
methods.description: Handles the interrupt by disabling further interrupts and signaling the thread or work queue.

methods.name: isl29035_lux_processed_to_raw
methods.description: Converts processed sensor value to raw lux data.

methods.name: isl29035_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attribute thresholds via I2C registers.

methods.name: isl29035_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, calls handle_int.

methods.name: isl29035_thread_cb
methods.description: Thread callback that reads the interrupt register and invokes user handler.

methods.name: isl29035_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets the trigger handler and enables interrupt.

methods.name: isl29035_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes interrupt GPIO and configures interrupt persistence.
